simple.meaning: גֵּרָה (gêrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a gerah or small weight (and coin).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גֵּרָה (H1626) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 30:13, with occurrences in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֵּרָה (H1626) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גֵּרָה (H1626) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גֵּרָה (gêrâh) / H1626 is traced through Exodus 30:13, Leviticus 27:25, Numbers 3:47, Numbers 18:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a gerah or small weight (and coin)
definitions.full: H1626. gerah II. גֵּרָה noun feminine a weight, 20th part of shekel, gerah (Assyrian girû , Zehnpf BAS i. 506 ) — גֵּרָה Exod 30:13 4 t. — Only in definition of שֶׁקֶל , with number עֶשְׂרִים 30:13 ; Lev 27:25 ; Num 3:47 ; 18:16 ; Ezek 45:12 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1641 (as in 1625 ); properly, (like 1620 ) a kernel (round as if scraped ), i.e.
